headline: Nigerian Parliamentary Committee Dismisses Fraud Claims Against NNPCL Executive
summary: A committee in Nigeria's House of Representatives dismissed money laundering allegations against NNPCL Executive Vice President Mumuni Dagazau after an investigation into civil society petitions.
why: Nigerian National Petroleum Company Limited is the state-owned oil firm managing the country's vast hydrocarbon assets and joint ventures.

impacts.name: NNPCL
impacts.why: Dismissal of regulatory charges reduces corporate governance uncertainty at the state oil firm.
